return(function(...)
local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local map={};for i=1,64 do map[string.byte(alphabet,i)]=i-1 end
local data=""
local chunks,buffer={},{};local count=0
local function put(value)
count+=1;buffer[#buffer+1]=string.char(bit32.bxor(value,(14+count*17)%256))
if #buffer>=2048 then chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(buffer);buffer={}end
end
for i=1,#data,4 do
local a,b,c,d=string.byte(data,i,i+3)
local n=(map[a]or 0)*262144+(map[b]or 0)*4096+(map[c]or 0)*64+(map[d]or 0)
put(math.floor(n/65536)%256)
if c~=61 then put(math.floor(n/256)%256)end
if d~=61 then put(n%256)end
end
chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(buffer)
local run,err=loadstring(table.concat(chunks),"=AstaLicensedCore");assert(run,err);return run(...)
end)(...)
